description: Rent Roll - A property management report listing current tenant and lease information for a real estate asset. Typically includes tenant names, unit numbers, lease start and end dates, rental rates, security deposits, occupancy status, square footage, and monthly or annual rental income. The first page often contains a summary of occupancy and total rental revenue, while the last page may include lease expiration schedules, delinquency details, concessions, or outstanding balances.
